scripts.coverage:unittest: python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest && python -m coverage report -m
scripts.coverage:js: c8 --all --src js --include "js/**/*.js" --exclude "js/vendor/**" --reporter=text --reporter=text-summary python -m unittest discover -s tests/unittest
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test.json --only firestore --project demo-jal-audit "node --test tests/integration/rules.test.cjs tests/integration/certificados.rules.test.cjs"
